decisionEvents.ret: "What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"I'm running on empty — have you got anything to spare? Anything? I can't keep going like this."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"Hey." Pavel settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Marcus sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? It'll pass."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"About the funniest thing you've seen — Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? Funny how that works."
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"Can I tell you something? I'm keeping a photo of someone I left behind. I haven't told anyone."
Adanech: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"About the talking-to-strangers part — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"Sure — Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"The way I read it — I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Can we talk?" Wanjiru sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Will you help me clean it?"
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Can we talk?" Brian sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"Hey. Got a minute? No reason. Just — hey."
"Look — Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first."
"About what you dream about — Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"About that news I was bursting to share — Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"Can we talk?" Rosa sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"I asked Franz about teaching them something — Franz's gone. Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"I asked Franz about that news I was bursting to share — Franz's gone. You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline. Doesn't matter now."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Ravi? What could go wrong."
"About that news I was bursting to share — Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first."
"Can I tell you something? I've been skimming extra food. I'm ashamed and I can't stop. ...if that makes sense."
"About teaching them something — Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them. — or so they tell me."
"I asked Hayden about teaching them something — Hayden's gone. Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't. Simple as that."
"I asked Hayden about that news I was bursting to share — Hayden's gone. Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"I asked Hayden about what you're good at — Hayden's gone. What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. I mean it."
"About that news I was bursting to share — You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline."
"Can I tell you something? I have been lying about my age — I'm younger than I look."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Kieran?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the ridge above the creek."
"About what you're good at — What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. Funny how that works."
"I asked Franz about the pantry run — Franz's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Where are you from — originally? Before all this."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
Show me what's hurt. Doesn't matter if it's a leg or a water pump. I'll look.
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the meadow edge, west of the creek."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Can I tell you something? I've been skimming extra food. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"Right, because that always works — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Adanech about what happened to my taken kin — Adanech's gone. I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. That's the priority."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"I asked Adanech about the pantry run — Adanech's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the old burn east of camp."
The System is a locked door. I'm collecting keys.
I've talked down three fights this month. It's a skill. A tiring one.
"About your first memory — What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing. You'd know about that."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Oh — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. …sorry."
"The pantry run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing. Take your time with it."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? I hope that helps."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I hate to ask, but do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here? Rest when you can."
"I asked Sari about the pantry run — Sari's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Sari about what you're hoping for — Sari's gone. What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"About your useful old-life skills — What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"About your useful old-life skills — What's something from your old life that's actually useful here? I mean it."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Bruno?"
I don't pick sides. I pick the group. Every time.
"Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 0 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
Everyone's allowed a bad day. Nobody's allowed two in a row. My rule.
"We're down to 6 liters of clean water. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Can we talk?" Debora keeps their voice low. "The stores. Have you looked at the stores? We're running thin."
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"I hate to ask, but do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"

◈ FLASHBACK — Trail compass
Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing.

💛 You hold Photo Album. Faces from before. Grace's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)

📺 The Vigil. One night, alone on the haven wall, the lamp lit. Below in the dark, something large is circling. Hold your post until dawn. Do not abandon the light.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Night. The haven wall. One lamp, lit. Below in the dark, something large is circling — you can see the grass move where it passes.

The System: "HOLD UNTIL DAWN. DO NOT ABANDON THE LIGHT."

The veterans who've held this wall won't say what's down there. "Just don't leave the lamp," they say. They don't say it

You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on).
